fieldNotes.location: Confirmed via web research as AllPoints at Anson Building 10, 4337 AllPoints Drive — a 605,000 sq ft (570' x 1,026') build-to-suit RDC opened 2023 for DTNA. Roster geocode moved 1,950 m; the rooftop pin landed near the building. Building center locked at 39.977550, -86.363000.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No fencing, no gate, no guard booth visible anywhere on the property. Spec-built Prologis park building with open perimeter drive and two open driveway connections (north and southwest) to AllPoints Drive. Open-site archetype.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Web spec sheet: 40 9'x10' dock doors plus two 12'x16' drive-in doors, all on the south long face. Satellite confirms a dock door rhythm and 140'-deep truck court on the south side.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Web spec sheet: 71 trailer parking spaces, expandable to 124. Imagery (2026 Maxar) shows striped trailer stalls along the south truck court but no trailers parked yet; capacity estimated ~90 mid-range.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Imagery captured shortly after construction shows the truck court empty — 0 trailers visible, low confidence on operational state.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Perimeter truck court is wide and deep (140' truck court plus loop drive); easily holds 3+ trucks staging before docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide, fully paved truck court and unused apron width — ample room for an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Two separate open driveway connections to AllPoints Drive (one at the north end by car parking, one at the southwest corner) function as distinct in/out routes.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town setting but within the dense 616-acre AllPoints at Anson industrial park in metro Indianapolis; classified Urban for the industrial-park density and metro proximity.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.

citations.claim: DTNA opened a new 605,000+ sq ft Redistribution Center (RDC) in Whitestown, IN to replenish its ten PDCs across the U.S. and Canada; an addition to the network.
DTNA's 605,000 sq ft RDC at 4337 AllPoints Drive is the company's SECOND facility in the park, complementing (not replacing) the 2017 PDC; leased (Prologis/Browning).

verification.rationale: DTNA-authored release + IBJ confirm a distinct, currently-operating leased RDC at 4337 AllPoints Drive; gauntlet found no Whitestown closure/consolidation.
